review_cost.rationale: All findings are nits I'd note rather than block on; I'd approve after one small pass.

findings.issue: Non-404 PokeAPI failures throw and no ErrorBoundary exists anywhere in the app, so upstream hiccups surface as a framework error page with no recovery path
findings.suggestion: Wrap the shell's route content in an ErrorBoundary in app.tsx with a small retry fallback

findings.issue: The entire layout (header, main, footer) is gated on the team-names query via <Show when={names()}>, coupling the global shell to one feature
findings.suggestion: Pass the team cookie into TeamProvider directly (or default to [] when unavailable) so the shell renders regardless of the query's state

findings.issue: Fetches have no timeout or AbortSignal, so a slow upstream API stalls SSR indefinitely
findings.suggestion: Use AbortSignal.timeout(10_000) or a comparable deadline on the fetch

findings.issue: The team size '6' is hardcoded in the template while MAX_TEAM already exists in team-store.ts
Two 'as any[]' casts (lines 101 and 139) drop type safety on generation/type records
findings.suggestion: Declare minimal record types for type and generation responses

findings.issue: Front-sprite URL construction is duplicated in card() (line 96) and homeList (line 175)
findings.suggestion: Extract a spriteUrl(id) helper next to card()

findings.issue: Pagination hrefs are assembled from raw URLSearchParams using the committed q, ignoring text typed within the 150ms debounce window
findings.suggestion: Build hrefs from text() (flushing pending input) or switch to A's search-param support

findings.issue: Expired cache entries are only removed every 500 writes, so the map can hold stale entries between sweeps
findings.suggestion: Sweep on a time interval or on insert when size exceeds a bound

findings.issue: All Suspense fallbacks are null, so refetch-triggered re-suspension (e.g. removing a team member on /team) blanks the page content briefly
findings.suggestion: Give the inner Suspense a minimal skeleton fallback so refetches don't flash empty

summary: This is a genuinely idiomatic SolidStart v2 app: query/use-server/createAsync/preload data loading, documented vite/nitro wiring, careful SSR-correct team state, and a clean single seam between routes and the server data module. The structure is sound and the code reads well, with only nits for a reviewer. My main asks before merge would be app-level error handling for upstream failures and decoupling the global shell from the team query.
